CustomField.description: The Marketing Dictionary Customer Type audience (e.g. Retail, SME) targeted by the offer version. Restrict delete keeps a dictionary entry from being removed while offers still reference it, so the value stays a single Id-based source of truth.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the customer-type audience (a Marketing Dictionary Customer Type entry, e.g. Retail or SME) this offer version targets.
CustomField.label: Customer Type
